developed_on: 2020-2022 seasons only (scripts/edge_lab.py); 2023-2025 untouched until this file is committed
test: Run ONCE on 2023-2025. Pass = mean CLV > 0 with one-sided p < 0.05/7 (Bonferroni for 7 candidates). ROI reported but not the pass test (too noisy). Every candidate is reported.

common.fair_sharp: median no-vig of lowvig, betonlineag, circasports, bookmaker
common.sanity: spread point within 2.5 of consensus; moneyline implied prob within 0.12 of consensus; spread price -200..+200; ML -1000..+1000; sharp line present
common.lock: one bet per game, at the first qualifying snapshot, best-scoring book/side at that snapshot
common.eligible: model-based rules only use snapshots after the injury report / QB confirmation (same rules as the replay)

candidates.rule: underdog side (point > 0) where EV at our book's line+price vs sharp fair (key-number pricing) >= 3%
underdog +100..+400 where EV vs sharp no-vig probability >= 3%
eligible snapshot; EV vs sharp >= 2% AND EV under frozen spread-v1 model blend >= 2%
eligible snapshot; EV vs sharp >= 2% AND EV under raw model probability >= 0
eligible snapshot; underdog; EV under frozen spread-v1 model blend >= 3%
eligible snapshot; price +150..+300; model win prob - sharp win prob >= 0.12
EV vs sharp >= 2% (any side), only while the strategy's last 20 settled bets have mean CLV > 0 (needs 10+ to gate)
